BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   B. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

4. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   C. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   D. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

8. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.

9. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   D. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

12. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   D. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Regulators in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
